scenarios.name: fly_on_hop_and_music
scenarios.description: fly-on to the water, three held DOWN hops to the music row (volume 0), Right starts DANCE looping, Left back to 0 sets one-shot, a hop to effects, Right starts PANT2, fire croaks OUCH, Up back to music lands into DANCE, then back flies everything off

scenarios.name: scores_row_and_controls_fly_off
scenarios.description: the high-score row shown: three titles and logs below them at the same pitch; the controls row flies off sliding the frog left and the extras away from x 0
